description: Furen's Armor Here's your armor, <name>. This will stand up to the strongest assaults or my name isn't Furen Longbeard! And I have to thank you. I learned a lot while working with the materials you brought me. I think I'll have another breakthrough one day! I'm going to send what I learned to other blacksmiths of the Alliance. I'll tell them you were a big help, and maybe they'll want to return the favor.
name: Furen's Armor
